notes: P1 Braun and Hogenberg plate (#1–#4, vol. 3, 1581) shows Arnhem as a small bird’s-eye town plan in one quarter of a four-town plate; passed over for Cuyp’s true view. Cuyp (#6) and van der Vinne (#10) are drawn on joined sheets; both trims stop at the join. Cornelis Pronk’s dated drawing of 26 June 1729 (#8) is a close, well-labeled alternative for P2. Rademaker #9 (1727–33) reconstructs the town ‘about 1630’, so skipped. Roth #13 is an imaginary view. NIMH aerials #22–#24 dated only 1920–40, and #22/#24 are not the city. #12’s engraver is not named in the record.
